videoAnalyses.title: 17 - Chest and Triceps B
videoAnalyses.summary: This video provides a 30-minute chest and triceps workout routine consisting of seven different exercises. Each exercise is performed for three sets of 10 repetitions, with a 60-second rest period between each set.

curriculum.targetTransformation: Build shoulders and chest that actually show

lessons.title: Press and fly your chest with dumbbells using correct form on every set
lessons.summary: Learners execute the Flat Bench Dumbbell Press and Dumbbell Flyes across three sets of 10 reps each, establishing the foundational pushing and stretching movement patterns for chest development.

sessions.title: Flat Bench Dumbbell Press and Dumbbell Flyes — Foundation Sets
sessions.summary: Follow along as both the Flat Bench Dumbbell Press and Dumbbell Flyes are demonstrated for 3 sets of 10 reps with 60-second rest periods, learning the core chest movements that anchor every future session.

steps.title: Log every set and rep for the Flat Bench Dumbbell Press and Dumbbell Flyes
Reflect on how the Flat Bench Dumbbell Press and Dumbbell Flyes felt differently on your chest

clips.chapterTitle: Flat Bench Dumbbell Press — 3 Sets of 10

lessons.title: Build chest strength across four machine and cable exercises in one complete session
lessons.summary: Learners follow a four-exercise chest circuit using the Machine Chest Press, Low Pulley Cable Fly, Machine Chest Fly, and Decline Cable Crossover — each for 3 sets of 10 reps — adding machine stability and cable tension to the dumbbell foundation.

sessions.title: Machine and Cable Chest Circuit — Four Exercises, Full Chest Coverage
sessions.summary: Work through the Machine Chest Press, Low Pulley Cable Fly, Machine Chest Fly, and Decline Cable Crossover across 17 minutes of structured 3×10 sets with 60-second rest periods, covering the chest from multiple angles using machines and cables.

steps.title: Compare the feel of the Machine Chest Press versus the Low Pulley Cable Fly during your sets
Reflect on how machine and cable resistance changes the chest training experience

clips.chapterTitle: Machine Chest Press, Low Pulley Cable Fly, Machine Chest Fly, and Decline Cable Crossover — 3 Sets of 10 Each

lessons.title: Finish the dumbbell chest session with Bench Push-Ups and Decline Cable Crossover
lessons.summary: Learners complete the Chest and Triceps A workout by performing Bench Push-Ups and the Decline Cable Crossover — adding bodyweight pushing volume and a cable finishing movement to close out the full chest routine.

sessions.title: Bench Push-Ups and Decline Cable Crossover — Close Out the Chest Session
sessions.summary: Follow the final two exercises of the Chest and Triceps A routine: Bench Push-Ups and Decline Cable Crossover, each for 3 sets of 10 reps with 60-second rest periods. These movements use bodyweight and cable resistance to finish the chest with a pressing and crossing pattern.

steps.title: Perform Bench Push-Ups and Decline Cable Crossover and record what you notice about fatigue and chest activation
Reflect on how the Bench Push-Up and Decline Cable Crossover felt at the end of the full chest session

clips.chapterTitle: Bench Push-Ups and Decline Cable Crossover — 3 Sets of 10 Each

lessons.title: Isolate and exhaust your triceps with Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdowns
lessons.summary: Learners target the triceps directly using Triceps Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdowns — each for 3 sets of 10 reps — completing the full Chest and Triceps B session and integrating triceps-specific volume into their upper body training.

sessions.title: Triceps Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdowns — Direct Triceps Training
sessions.summary: Follow the triceps half of Chest and Triceps B: Triceps Bench Dips (bodyweight, 3×10) and Cable Rope Pushdowns (cable, 3×10) with 60-second rest periods. These two exercises isolate the triceps to finish the upper body program.

steps.title: Execute all 3 sets of Triceps Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdowns and log the difference in triceps fatigue between the two movements
Reflect on how the Triceps Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdowns complete your upper body training picture

clips.chapterTitle: Triceps Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdowns — 3 Sets of 10 Each
